target_customer: Product, design and research teams at startups, enterprises and research agencies
problem: Customer research is slow: recruiting, moderating interviews and synthesizing transcripts take weeks.

founders.name: David Correa Orozco
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: In early 2023 the first product (AI summaries of interview recordings) wrapped large language models around transcripts; moderation by AI came later.

defensibility.rationale: Thin wrapper on third party models; later comparisons show many rivals such as Outset (YC S23) and Koji.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents acquiring or copying Versive; incumbents named from general market, not a dated source.

market_need_then: Teams wanted faster synthesis of interview data as generative AI emerged in late 2022 to 2023; no dated spend figures found.

branding.domain_note: Uses getversive.com, a 'get' prefix domain (company site).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, promotional, speed focused ('in minutes', no recruiting needed).

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself found.

pivots.from: AI synthesis of uploaded user interviews (YC launch)
pivots.to: AI moderated surveys and interviews, AI persona usability tests
pivots.why: Not stated; product expanded per company site

outcome_analysis: Versive is a three person company that still operates, expanding from interview synthesis to AI moderated studies and AI persona tests. No priced round, exit or customer count is publicly sourced, and rivals like Outset entered at the same time, so its trajectory is unclear.
notes: Funding: Caplight and startup-seeker (aggregators) report $500K seed around 2023; unverified, not a round. Other 'Versive' funding figures belong to different companies. Aggregators name the founders as David Carro or Correa Orozco; YC page used. Outset (YC S23) is a contemporaneous rival but no dated source for its early state was opened, so the competitor list is empty. Name origin not found.
